hints.title: Double String for Cyclic Window
hints.text: Concatenate s with itself s + s to represent all cyclic rotations as contiguous windows of size n.

hints.title: Compare Against Alternating Templates
hints.text: Generate target alternating patterns starting with 0 and starting with 1 over length 2 * n.

hints.title: Sliding Window Mismatch Count
hints.text: Slide a window of size n across the doubled string, maintaining mismatch counts for both patterns.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is length of string s
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all cyclic rotations independently takes O(n^2) operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sliding window of length n over doubled string s+s tracks mismatches in linear O(n) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles window slide by decrementing expired character mismatches.
